templates.title: Project templates
templates.description: Reusable project stages, tasks and milestones.
templates.applyHint: A new independent project will be created from this start date.

stages.title: Stages
stages.hint: Choose a stage for each task. Move its tasks before removing a stage.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.hint: The offset is calculated from the project start date.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.hint: Choose a stage, milestone and predecessor tasks.

validation.stageInUse: Move the tasks in this stage to another stage before removing it.
validation.duplicateReference: Each stage, milestone and task must be unique. Select each predecessor only once.
validation.missingStage: Choose an existing stage for every task.
validation.missingMilestone: Choose an existing milestone or No milestone.
validation.missingDependency: Choose predecessor tasks that still exist.
validation.dependencyCycle: Predecessor tasks form a loop. Remove a dependency to break the loop.
validation.invalidFields: Enter all names and check offsets (-3650 to 3650), durations (1 to 3650) and the limit of 100 rows per section.
validation.applyFields: Enter a project name and a valid start date.
